title: Lab 8 - Your own runner and Auto DevOps
description: Install and register a docker runner with tags, tune config.toml, then let Auto DevOps build and test a project.
scenario: Run the XYZ pipeline on a runner you own, harden a deploy runner, and compare your pipeline with the one Auto DevOps generates.
environment_setup:
# A gitlab.com account (free tier is enough) with shared runners enabled on the project,
# git on your machine, and a terminal. Keep Build → Pipelines open in a second tab.
git --version
git remote -v
cleanup: # Nothing to clean: pipelines and jobs are history. Delete the scratch project when the track is over.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Install and register
tasks.instructions: On a Linux VM install gitlab-runner and Docker; create a project runner in the UI with tag docker-lab, untagged off; register with the authentication token, executor docker, default image alpine:3.20.
tasks.solution: sudo gitlab-runner register --non-interactive --url https://gitlab.com --token glrt-… --executor docker --docker-image alpine:3.20
tasks.verification: Runner shows online; a job with tags: [docker-lab] runs on it (log names your runner).

tasks.title: Task 2 - config.toml
tasks.instructions: Set concurrent = 2, privileged = true, pull_policy = ["if-not-present","always"], and a /cache volume; restart; run the dind build job on your runner.
tasks.verification: The dind build passes on your runner; the second run pulls fewer layers.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Deploy runner
tasks.instructions: Add a second [[runners]] entry: shell executor, limit = 1, tag deploy, protected (protected refs only); give deploy jobs tags: [deploy].
tasks.verification: A feature-branch job with tags: [deploy] stays pending (runner takes protected refs only); a main deploy runs.

tasks.title: Task 4 - Auto DevOps
tasks.instructions: Create a new empty project from the nodejs-app code WITHOUT .gitlab-ci.yml; enable Auto DevOps; run a pipeline; then add a .gitlab-ci.yml that includes Auto-DevOps.gitlab-ci.yml and overrides the test job.
tasks.solution:
include:
  - template: Auto-DevOps.gitlab-ci.yml
test:
  image: node:20-alpine
  script: ["npm ci", "npm test"]
tasks.verification: First pipeline: build + test + scanners run, deploy skipped (no cluster); second: your test job replaces the generated one.
